scope: Proposition 9.2 (Status preparation) of the manuscript “A counterexample to Hadwiger's conjecture” (preprints/A-counterexample-to-Hadwigers-conjecture-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 157 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 a97293542586d351), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 51. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Along a subsequence, the unit law can be prepared with final pin dimension at most K and the final per-leaf bounds of Lemma 4.5, at relative mass cost 2−o(N), so that one of the following descriptions applies. (i) There is no prediction as in Definition 9.1 on the first-peeled law. The effective spaces are still the first ones. For independent units, the mass admitting an admissible injecting small table is greater than .99. (ii) A prediction with fixed αi, c and common classes ei is retained. The old marks and exceptions are preserved, and Equation (9.1) has uniform o(1) error on every retained unit. The mass admitting an admissible injecting table satisfying Equation (9.3) is bounded below by a positive constant. (iii) Both prediction classes are zero, and every retained unit satisfies the exact identities pi = T(λi, ·) + a on all of X, i = 1, 2. There is a set of leaf pairs of mass at least c2N−4 under the final leaf mixture, for a fixed c2 > 0, with phase compatibility determined by the two leaves. For each such pair one can choose a specific injecting compatible table whose two separate orientation admissibility filters have masses at least a0 > 0. The constants c2, a0 are independent of n. In every case the mixed joint density is at most 2(D+o(1))N µ2, and its individual marginals are at most M2o(N)µ. Relative to the stored leaf bases and pin images, all numerical table formats, unary statuses, old-mark coordinates and exception-set descriptions have bounded length in n. The extra exact pins are used only in case (iii).
